title: `merge --ready` does not push a records page after the lane lint has passed, or the lint is read again at the new head
why: Sighting (runner 10 11:44 CST Nov 14, its own words; triage read nothing): `merge --ready` pushed a records page to #3405 (its first push since 08:00) after the lane lint passed, so the linted head and the head now differ. Why it matters, from decision text triage read earlier tonight: a combined or ready PR needs a lane-lint PASS at its head (coordinator's 10:44 relay of the combine-train-tool lane's read of `--reviewed`). Whether a PASS on the older head still counts is unread. Kin: records-page-before-ready, fast-checks-before-ready (now merged: `merge --ready` runs the ready checks then the records step), lane-lint-before-push. First act of a lane: read the order of the ready checks and the records push in merge.py; reproduce, red then green: after `merge --ready` pushes a records page, the lint result is read at the new head (or the page is pushed before the lint). A check-order change; if a verdict changes, round 3 applies.
